controles.affirmation: Dans l'affaire ad tech, le tribunal a deja juge en avril 2025 que les outils editeurs de Google excluaient ILLEGALEMENT les rivaux.
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2025, the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia issued a mixed decision in the DOJ case against Google, ruling that neither Google's advertiser tools nor the DoubleClick and AdMeld acquisitions were anticompetitive, but that Google's publisher tools unfairly excluded rivals.
controles.correction_proposee: Deux ecarts. (1) Le filing ecrit « unfairly excluded rivals » (de maniere deloyale), pas « illegalement ». (2) L'ATT omet que la decision est qualifiee de MIXTE : le tribunal a juge que ni les outils annonceurs ni les acquisitions DoubleClick et AdMeld n'etaient anticoncurrentiels. Reformuler : « decision mixte en avril 2025 : outils annonceurs et acquisitions DoubleClick/AdMeld juges non anticoncurrentiels, mais outils editeurs juges avoir exclu les rivaux de maniere deloyale. » Verifie personnellement contre le 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: Programme ATM de 40 Mds $ supplementaires, presente comme source de financement du capex IA.
controles.verbatim_source: Additionally, we entered into an equity distribution agreement with certain sales agents to sell up to $40.0 billion of our Class A stock and Class C stock from time to time through an ATM Program. The proceeds of the ATM Program are primarily intended to be used to meet tax obligations associated with employee equity grants. As of June 30, 2026, we have not sold any shares under the ATM Program.
controles.correction_proposee: Deux ecarts. (1) Le filing precise que les produits de l'ATM sont destines EN PRIORITE aux obligations fiscales liees aux actions attribuees aux salaries, pas au financement du capex IA. (2) Aucune action n'avait ete vendue au 30 juin 2026 : c'est une autorisation, pas un financement leve. Reformuler : « autorisation ATM de 40 Mds $ mise en place en juin 2026, non utilisee au 30 juin 2026, destinee en priorite aux obligations fiscales sur actions salariees. » Verifie personnellement contre le 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: Le resultat net du T2 2026 inclut 99,0 Mds $ de gains NON REALISES sur titres.
controles.verbatim_source: OI&E of $98.0 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026 included net gains on equity securities of $99.0 billion, primarily related to unrealized gains in our equity securities portfolio from SpaceX and a private company.
controles.correction_proposee: Le filing dit 99,0 Mds $ de gains NETS sur titres de participation, PRINCIPALEMENT (primarily) lies a des plus-values latentes sur SpaceX et une societe privee. Il ne dit pas que la totalite des 99,0 Mds $ est non realisee. Reformuler : « 99,0 Mds $ de gains nets sur titres de participation, principalement des plus-values latentes sur SpaceX et une societe privee. » Verifie personnellement contre le 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: Nuance bull : amende AdSense de 1,5 Md EUR annulee en Europe.
controles.verbatim_source: In September 2024, the General Court overturned the EC decision and annulled the EUR 1.5 billion fine. The EC has appealed the General Court's decision with the European Court of Justice, which remains pending.
controles.correction_proposee: L'annulation n'est pas definitive : la Commission a fait appel devant la Cour de justice et cet appel est toujours pendant. Ajouter « annulation frappee d'appel par la Commission, procedure toujours pendante devant la Cour de justice ».

controles.affirmation: Zero rachat d'actions au S1 2026 alors que la ste en faisait 13 a 16 Mds $ par trimestre en 2021-2024 ; dette stable autour de 13-15 Mds $ de 2021 a debut 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: In the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, there were no repurchases of the company's Class A or Class C shares. — Series internes kpis-haut : buybacks Q1-2021 11,4 ; Q2-2021 12,8 ; Q3-2021 12,6 ; Q4-2021 13,5 Mds $. Series lt_debt : Q3-2024 12,3 ; Q4-2024 10,9 ; Q1-2025 10,9 Mds $.
controles.correction_proposee: Le zero rachat est exact et bien source. Mais les fourchettes historiques sont fausses : les rachats vont de 11 a 16 Mds $ par trimestre sur 2021-2024 (et non 13 a 16), et la dette long terme de 11 a 15 Mds $ de 2021 a debut 2025 (10,9 Mds $ aux T4 2024 et T1 2025), et non 13 a 15. Elargir les deux fourchettes.

controles.affirmation: Affaire DOJ Search : jugement final rendu en decembre 2025, imposant des restrictions sur la distribution des services et obligeant Google a partager certaines donnees de recherche et a offrir des services de syndication a des concurrents.
controles.verbatim_source: A final judgment was entered in December 2025, which, among other things, imposes restrictions on how Google distributes its services and requires Google to share certain search data with and offer syndication services to certain competitors.

controles.affirmation: L'appel est en cours dans les deux sens (Google et le DOJ ont fait appel).
controles.verbatim_source: In January 2026, we appealed the final judgment and moved to pause implementation of certain remedies. The court denied the motion to stay as premature, allowing Google to seek a stay until the scope of certain remedies are more defined. In February 2026, the DOJ and state Attorneys General also appealed.

controles.affirmation: La societe ecrit elle-meme que la proposition de remedes du DOJ contient des remedes structurels pouvant avoir un effet defavorable significatif ; le jugement sur les remedes est attendu.
controles.verbatim_source: The DOJ's remedy proposal includes structural remedies that could have a material adverse effect on our business. Closing arguments were held in November 2025, and we are awaiting a final judgment.

controles.affirmation: En juillet 2026, la Cour de justice de l'UE a rejete le dernier recours dans l'affaire Android : l'amende est devenue definitive et 5,2 Mds $ ont ete payes en cash.
controles.verbatim_source: We subsequently appealed the General Court's affirmation of the EC decision, which was denied by the European Court of Justice in July 2026. The EC decision is now final. In July 2026, we made a cash payment of $5.2 billion for the fine plus accrued interest.

controles.affirmation: Amende ad tech de la Commission europeenne de 3,0 Mds EUR, charge de 3,5 Mds $ prise au T3 2025, appel en cours.
controles.verbatim_source: The EC decision imposed a EUR 3.0 billion fine and directed Google to cease and desist the alleged "self-preferencing" practices. We appealed the ruling in November 2025, which remains pending. We recognized a charge of $3.5 billion in the third quarter of 2025, and we placed bank guarantees in the fourth quarter of 2025 in lieu of cash payment.

controles.affirmation: Une condamnation privee de 2,1 Mds $ en Suede (PriceRunner/Klarna), provisionnee au T2 2026, appel en cours.
controles.verbatim_source: In the second quarter of 2026, we accrued $2.1 billion in legal charges related to a Stockholm Patent and Market Court decision regarding a private action brought against Google by PriceRunner (a subsidiary of Klarna). The principal damages of $1.5 billion were accrued in general and administrative expenses in our Google Services segment, and accrued interest and costs of $581 million was recognized in other income (expense), net. ... We appealed the decision.

controles.affirmation: Des constats preliminaires de non-conformite au DMA sur Google Play et Search.
controles.verbatim_source: In March 2024, the EC opened two investigations regarding Google's compliance with certain provisions of the European Union's (EU) Digital Markets Act relating to Google Play and Search. In March 2025, the EC issued preliminary findings of non-compliance in both investigations, to which we responded.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE : 17,4 Mds $ d'amendes et reglements provisionnes a court terme au 30 juin 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, we had short-term accrued legal and regulatory fines and settlements of $17.4 billion. This amount primarily included EC fines, in addition to accruals related to other legal matters and regulatory fines and settlements.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE : 811,0 Mds $ d'engagements d'achats contractuels au 30 juin 2026, dont 200,7 Mds $ a moins d'un an, plus 85,2 Mds $ de loyers de datacenters non demarres.
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, we had material purchase commitments and other contractual obligations totaling $811.0 billion, of which $200.7 billion was short-term. ... As of June 30, 2026, we have entered into leases, primarily related to data centers, that have not yet commenced with future lease payments of $85.2 billion.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE : garanties financieres jusqu'a 51,4 Mds $ (7,6 Mds $ de garanties + 43,8 Mds $ de derives de credit), plus 24,1 Mds $ de backstops supplementaires prevus.
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, we provided backstops in the form of financial guarantees and credit derivatives with maximum potential amount of future payments of $7.6 billion and $43.8 billion, respectively. ... We have also entered into an agreement to provide an estimated $24.1 billion of future backstops to support the build-out of data center and energy supply infrastructure, subject to finalization of terms with data center providers.
